## File: facebookresearch_grounded-video-description/tools/densevid_eval/coco-caption/pycocotools/coco.py

Prompts

```
['load a COCO annotation JSON file into memory and create an index for fast lookup', 'get annotation IDs filtered by image IDs, category IDs, area range, or crowd label', 'decode a binary mask encoded via run-length encoding into a 2D boolean numpy array', 'encode a 2D boolean numpy array into run-length encoding format for compact storage', 'convert polygon segmentation coordinates into a binary mask of specified height and width']
```

Usage

```
{'load_coco_annotations': 'load a COCO annotation JSON file into memory and create an index for fast lookup', 'get_ann_ids': 'get annotation IDs filtered by image IDs, category IDs, area range, or crowd label', 'decode_mask': 'decode a binary mask encoded via run-length encoding into a 2D boolean numpy array', 'encode_mask': 'encode a 2D boolean numpy array into run-length encoding format for compact storage', 'seg_to_mask': 'convert polygon segmentation coordinates into a binary mask of specified height and width'}
```
